name: Task

<!--
  One task, one branch, one PR. If it needs splitting, it was two tasks.
  The title says what is WRONG, not what to add — the house commit style:
  "the desk does not know what day it is", not "add a publishing schedule".
  Label it with one type (feat/fix/refactor/docs/chore) and at most one area.
-->

**What** — one line.

**Why** — the fault it closes, or what it unblocks. **Link the doc, do not
restate it**: `GAZETTA.md` and `PLATFORM_NOTES.md` hold the reasoning, and an
argument copied into an issue is a second copy that goes stale.

**Branch** — `feat/…`, the name it will take.

**Done when** — the observable thing that proves it. Never "implemented".

<!--
  Blocked? Say what is blocking it AND who can clear it. A blocker with no
  owner is a wish. Add the `blocked` label.
-->
